Notable Comments and Features:
*PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS 5 min walk away

*400 yds to the beach. Very easy walk, no busy street to cross

NOT SO HUMBLE BRAG-->-->-->-->-->-->
We are happy to answer all of your questions and look forward to your inquiry. You may find though that we are a little biased when it comes to bragging about our home and its location. For a real idea of what it's like to stay at Eastern Sunsets, enter key search terms under our reviews for common answers to your questions. "Walk to the beach" "Cleanliness" "Location" "Amenities". We're happy to have our guests do the bragging for us.

*Other listings provided by this 5-star host
682407 - Burning Daylight Over 130 5-star reviews (rent both for large groups)
832244 - Sea Oaks Over 80 5-star reviews in Inlet Beach

New custom home centrally located in Seagrove Beach on Eastern Lake, one of 30A's iconic Dune Lakes. The home is a 400 yd walk to the white sandy beach and an even faster paddle board ride (two SUP’s and a kayak included for your stay) to the outfall where the lake and Gulf come together. This home is the ultimate vacation haven for friends and family to gather and reconnect. You are a quick bike ride to all of the fun, restaurants and shopping that 30A has to offer. Your days can be spent exploring the 24 miles from Grayton Beach to Rosemary Beach with world class restaurants, shopping, hiking trails, and fun pitstops for photos and breathtaking views of this special stretch of beach and unique scenery.

This home has three primary suites. The bedrooms are outfitted with luxurious linens, multiple pillows and blackout shades for long restful nights. Each bedroom also has a desk for the most productive go-getters in the group.

Suite 1 - First floor with king bed and private bathroom

Suite 2- Second floor with king bed and private bathroom that includes a tub

Suite 3- Second floor with king bed and private bathroom that includes a tub

The two bunk rooms that sleep 4-each, flank a sleep-away-camp style bunk-room bathroom with two shower stalls, two water closets and a three faucet trough sink. There’s enough space for 8 roomies to get ready for a day at the beach or slumber party with their bunkmates come bedtime. Each bunk, equipped with a charging station and a reading light. There are TVs in both bunk rooms.

The gourmet kitchen includes a 6-burner gas stove, TWO dishwashers, large fridge and freezer as well as beverage fridge and wine fridge in the butler's pantry. Everything you need for cooking the most elaborate meals is provided for you. The large dining table is big enough for the whole house to crowd around and seating at the bar for any spillover. From coffee to cocktails, you won’t be lacking for any of the necessities to begin or end your day.

Take your drinks, books or yoga mat out to the back porch overlooking the pool and Eastern Lake or check out the upstairs library where you can lounge on the window seat for a bird’s eye view of the lake and Gulf of Mexico.

The media room provides another spot to getaway or pull everyone together over a board-game, favorite movie or to try for the high score on Mrs Pac Man or Galaga. This home offers spots for a lot of togetherness and places for a few quiet moments of peace.

Eastern Sunsets will no doubt become the perfect backdrop for some of your most favorite vacation memories.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
